method: 250m native cell centres within GISCO NUTS2 2024 1:1M polygons; all touched cells for sites; values >0 within native range, not a scientific accuracy test
limits: positive admissible values proxy; authoritative per-property missingness must be cross-checked
GISCO 1:1M boundary approximation at 250m cell centres
site coverage counts use all-touched cells, not area weighting
